column3: With respect to the ExchangeRight Net Leased Portfolio #72 Mortgage Loan (as to each of the Sutter Healthcare - Modesto, CA Mortgaged Property, the SLB Tractor Supply – Clio, MI Mortgaged Property, the SLB Tractor Supply – Clare, MI Mortgaged Property, the SLB Tractor Supply – Hudson, MI Mortgaged Property and the SLB Tractor Supply – Muskegon, MI Mortgaged Property (collectively, 2.3%)), the related single tenant has a ROFR to purchase such Mortgaged Property. With respect to each lease for the SLB Tractor Supply – Clio, MI Mortgaged Property, the SLB Tractor Supply – Clare, MI Mortgaged Property, the SLB Tractor Supply – Hudson, MI Mortgaged Property and the SLB Tractor Supply – Muskegon, MI Mortgaged Property, the related tenant entered into a subordination non-disturbance and attornment agreement (“SNDA”) pursuant to which it agreed its ROFR would be subordinate to the related mortgage; however, such SNDAs do not provide that such right would not apply upon a foreclosure or deed-in-lieu thereof. With respect to the lease for the Sutter Healthcare - Modesto, CA Mortgaged Property (0.7%), the tenant provided an SNDA which states that such right will not arise as result of a foreclosure, deed-in-lieu of foreclosure, any offer, notice, pleading, agreement, transaction or other event or condition arising out of or relating to any of the foregoing, or the first subsequent transfer following a foreclosure or deed-in-lieu thereof.
